value.description: ECOG performance status score describing the patient's level of functioning and ability to perform daily activities.

value.title: Surgery
value.description: Surgery performed before or after radiopharmaceutical therapy (RPT).

days_to_surgery.description: The number of days from the index date to the date of surgery, in accordance with HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification.

primary_tumor_removal.description: Whether the primary tumor has been removed through surgery.

days_between_surgery_and_rpt.description: Time in days between the surgery event and the start of RPT treatment.

pre_surgery_tumor_volume.description: Tumor volume pre-surgery, in mL, if debulking surgery was performed.

post_surgery_tumor_volume.description: Tumor volume post-surgery, in mL, if debulking surgery was performed.

debulking_threshold.description: The goal optimal debulking threshold depending on cancer type; typically around 0.7 for neuroendocrine tumors (NETs).

cases.description: The submitter_id or id of the case record(s) this surgery is related to, i.e., a link to a record in the parent node.

value.title: Other Treatment
value.description: General information regarding treatments other than RPT given before or alongside it, including hormone therapy, chemotherapy, somatostatin analog therapy, etc.

therapy_type.description: Type of therapy applied before or alongside RPT.

days_to_therapy_start.description: The number of days from the index date to the start of this therapy, in accordance with HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification.

days_to_therapy_end.description: The number of days from the index date to the end of this therapy, in accordance with HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification.

days_between_therapy_and_rpt.description: Time in days between the end of this therapy and the start of RPT.

pre_therapy_tumor_volume.description: Tumor volume before the start of this therapy, in mL.

post_therapy_tumor_volume.description: Tumor volume after this therapy, in mL.

response_to_therapy.description: Response to this therapy: whether it was completed or stopped, and the reasoning.

response_criteria.description: Criteria used to assess response to this therapy.

cases.description: The submitter_id or id of the case record(s) this other_treatment is related to, i.e., a link to a record in the parent node.

value.title: Tumor
value.description: Tumor information prior to RPT treatment.

ajcc_stage.description: Staging of cancer progression according to the AJCC system.

tumor_grade.description: Categorization of the tumor by level of cell differentiation, determined through analysis of tissue samples.

extra_abdominal_mets.description: Whether the tumor has metastasized outside the abdomen.

ki_67.description: Ki-67 marker expression (%), strongly associated with tumor cell proliferation and growth.

cases.description: The submitter_id or id of the case record(s) this tumor is related to, i.e., a link to a record in the parent node.

value.title: Treatment Course
value.description: An overall course of radiopharmaceutical therapy (RPT) treatments.

radiopharmaceutical.description: Name of the radiopharmaceutical administered, e.g. [177Lu]Lu-DOTATATE.

radiation_type.description: Type of ionizing radiation delivered by the radiopharmaceutical.

number_of_cycles.description: The number of treatment cycles in this course.

days_to_treatment_start.description: The number of days from the index date to the start of this treatment course, in accordance with HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification.

cases.description: The submitter_id or id of the case record(s) this treatment_course is related to, i.e., a link to a record in the parent node.

value.title: Treatment Cycle
value.description: A single cycle of RPT treatment, including the activity administered.

cycle_number.description: The sequential number of this treatment cycle within the treatment course.

administered_activity.description: Net activity injected during this treatment cycle, in MBq.

therapeutic_target.description: Intended molecular or anatomical therapeutic target, e.g. SSTR2.

treatment_courses.description: The submitter_id or id of the treatment_course record(s) this treatment_cycle is related to, i.e., a link to a record in the parent node.

value.title: Laboratory Test
value.description: A laboratory test result linked to an RPT treatment cycle, e.g. renal function and blood work.

loinc_code.description: LOINC code identifying the laboratory test performed.

lab_value.description: Numeric result of the laboratory test.

lab_unit.description: Unit of measurement for the laboratory test result.

days_from_cycle_start.description: Days from the start of the treatment cycle at which the sample was collected.

treatment_cycles.description: The submitter_id or id of the treatment_cycle record(s) this laboratory_test is related to, i.e., a link to a record in the parent node.

value.title: Absorbed Dose
value.description: Absorbed dose estimate for a target organ or lesion within an RPT treatment cycle.

dose_target.description: Anatomical target for which absorbed dose was calculated.

lesion_id.description: Lesion ID used to track lesion identity and lifecycle across treatment cycles.

mean_absorbed_dose.description: Mean absorbed dose delivered to the target, in Gy.

sd_absorbed_dose.description: Standard deviation of the absorbed dose, in Gy.

d50.description: Minimum absorbed dose received by the hottest 50% of the target volume, in Gy.

d90.description: Minimum absorbed dose received by the hottest 90% of the target volume, in Gy.

lesion_volume.description: Lesion volume in mL, tracked across treatment cycles to monitor response.

cycle_number.description: Treatment cycle number to which this dose estimate corresponds.

dosimetry_method.description: Computational method used to derive the absorbed dose estimate.

dosimetry_software.description: Software used to perform dosimetry calculations, e.g. OLINDA, MIM, Michigan Dosimetry Code.

time_activity_curve_fit.description: Functional form used to fit the time-activity curve, e.g. monoexponential.

treatment_cycles.description: The submitter_id or id of the treatment_cycle record(s) this absorbed_dose is related to, i.e., a link to a record in the parent node.

imaging_studies.description: The submitter_id or id of the imaging_study record(s) this absorbed_dose is related to, i.e., a link to a record in the parent node.

value.title: Clinical Outcome
value.description: Clinical outcome data linked to an RPT treatment cycle and/or dosimetry results, capturing treatment response and toxicity.

treatment_response.description: Treatment response assessment per RECIST or PERCIST criteria.

progression_free_survival.description: Length of time in months during and after treatment that the patient lives without disease progression.

overall_survival.description: Length of time in months from the start of treatment until death from any cause.

toxicity_organ.description: Organ in which toxicity was observed.

days_to_progression.description: Number of days from treatment start to documented disease progression.

treatment_cycles.description: The submitter_id or id of the treatment_cycle record(s) this clinical_outcome is related to, i.e., a link to a record in the parent node.

absorbed_doses.description: The submitter_id or id of the absorbed_dose record(s) this clinical_outcome is related to, i.e., a link to a record in the parent node.
